origin_issue.title: [BACKEND] [STORY] Putaway: Generate Put-away Tasks from Staging

questions.question_text: If multiple put-away rules could apply to a single product (e.g., a product-specific rule and a category-level rule), what is the definitive order of precedence?

answer.enforcement: Higher-precedence rules override lower ones. Conflicts at the same level are configuration errors and must be rejected at setup time.

questions.question_text: Should a single receipt line item always result in a single put-away task? Or should the system group multiple line items heading to the same destination into one consolidated task?

answer.decision: One receipt line item → one putaway task by default
answer.rationale: Preserves traceability between receipt, SKU, and movement. Simplifies audit, reconciliation, and exception handling.

allowed_when_all_true: Same handling constraints (lot, expiry, serial rules)
optional_consolidation.requirement: Maintain internal line references to original receipt lines

questions.question_text: The original story states tasks are 'assignable.' What is the expected mechanism? Does a manager manually assign tasks, or can any authorized Stock Clerk claim an unassigned task from a shared pool?

answer.decision: Shared pool with self-claim, plus optional manager assignment

permissions.CLAIM_PUTAWAY_TASK: Any user may claim, execute, and complete tasks

permissions.ASSIGN_PUTAWAY_TASK: May pre-assign tasks, reassign tasks, override claims

answer.rationale: Matches warehouse reality (work-stealing model). Avoids bottlenecks from mandatory manual assignment. Still allows supervisory control.

questions.question_text: What is the required system behavior if a rule's suggested destination is full or otherwise unavailable at the time of task generation? Should it look for the next-best location, or flag the task for manual intervention?

answer.decision: Automatic fallback at generation time; manual intervention only if no valid fallback exists

then: Attempt next-best location using same rule precedence, same compatibility constraints, same layout ranking logic

manual_intervention.only_when: No valid location exists that satisfies rules and constraints

explicitly_disallowed: Generating a task pointing to a known-invalid or full location
